abstract: Spontaneous regression of metastatic neoplasia is rate. A review of previously reported spontaneous regressions of testicular cancer indicates that in no case has such a patient had a prior, concurrent, or subsequent contralateral tumor. The case presented is unusual because it is the first instance of bilateral sequential testicular cancer in which spontaneous regression of metastases from one of the tumors has been noted. Together with a previous report of a spontaneous regression of testicular cancer which occurred only after a second orchiectomy, the present case suggests the possibility of hormonal modulation of tumor growth.
abstract_ja: 転移性腫瘍の自然退縮は稀である。既報の精巣がんの自然退縮例を検討したところ、対側に先行、同時、または後発の腫瘍を伴った患者は一例もなかった。本症例は、両側性に逐次発生した精巣がんのうち一方の腫瘍からの転移巣の自然退縮が認められた初めての例であり、特異である。二度目の精巣摘除術の後にのみ精巣がんの自然退縮が生じた既報と合わせると、腫瘍増殖のホルモン性修飾の可能性が示唆される。
